unit.why: A single anecdote: R. Zvi travels to the Seer of Lublin to learn to pray, and the Seer has R. Moshe Sofer of Przeworsk write him tefillin, which are later handed down by will.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מא״ז הק׳ ר׳ צבי ז״ל
stories.end_quote: ליד דודו הנ״ל ועדיין הם כשרים
stories.summary_en: As a young man supported by his father-in-law, R. Zvi travels to the Seer of Lublin to learn how to pray; the Seer takes one ruble from him and has R. Moshe Sofer of Przeworsk write him kosher tefillin, which R. Zvi keeps all his life and which pass by will to R. David of Kotsk.

והתפילין היו אצלו כל ימי חייו
